extension.description: KlempCinema propojuje Kodi s vasim uctem na Webshare a umoznuje prochazet dostupne soubory s metadaty z TMDB. Pouzivejte pouze obsah, ke kteremu mate opravneny pristup. Pred prvnim pouzitim vyplnte prihlasovaci udaje k Webshare v nastaveni doplnku.

KlempCinema connects Kodi to your Webshare account so you can browse files available to that account, with TMDB metadata. Only use content you are authorized to access. Enter your Webshare credentials in the addon settings before first use.
extension.disclaimer: Doplnek nehostuje soubory. Neuplne vysledky znamena, ze v uctu nebyly nalezeny rozpoznatelne soubory.
This addon does not host files. Incomplete results mean no matching files were found for your account.
